title: Judge the Outcome, Not the Craft
notes_html:
Old skill, new worker. This is how managers have always led experts they couldn't replace - engineers, actuaries, surgeons, cybersecurity specialists. The habits transfer almost unchanged.

The one difference. You can often hear a person's doubt; an AI's polish sounds the same either way. Step 4 is where asking for it gets built in.

From my own career. I have had managers who could not program. They used peer reviews to have us build acceptable plans, and then managed us to completion of those plans.

Related. Research Partner, Not All-Knowing Oracle checks the sources. Test Adversarially is independent review. Models Are Not Good at Math checks the numbers with code. Ghost in the Workflow means no single black box. AI as Amplifier is why your judgment matters. Right Tool, Right Job picks the second model, and The Chat Is Not Your Memory keeps the record it reads.
strip: Paste this into any AI system's custom instructions or at the start of a conversation to run Judge the Outcome, Not the Craft. It sets the goal and the checks first, states its confidence, and leaves the business call with you.
